targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, storage_partition_id::text AS metric, verified_rate AS value FROM analytics.grounding_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND ('$tenant_id' = 'all' OR storage_partition_id::text = '$tenant_id') ORDER BY 1

SELECT bucket AS time, storage_partition_id::text || ' p50' AS metric, p50 AS value FROM analytics.nli_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND ('$tenant_id' = 'all' OR storage_partition_id::text = '$tenant_id') UNION ALL SELECT bucket AS time, storage_partition_id::text || ' p95' AS metric, p95 AS value FROM analytics.nli_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND ('$tenant_id' = 'all' OR storage_partition_id::text = '$tenant_id') ORDER BY 1

SELECT model_or_evaluator AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM analytics.scores WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'citation_verified' AND ('$tenant_id' = 'all' OR storage_partition_id::text = '$tenant_id') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT jsonb_array_length(payload #> '{record,citations}') AS citations, count(*) FROM analytics.turn_lineage WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND record_kind = 4 AND ('$tenant_id' = 'all' OR storage_partition_id::text = '$tenant_id') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

list.definition: SELECT 'all' AS tenant_id UNION SELECT DISTINCT storage_partition_id::text AS tenant_id FROM analytics.turn_lineage ORDER BY 1
